parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The parameter name. **The Name parameter in this operation supports fuzzy match.**

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The parameter path. For example, if Name is /path/path1/Myparameter, the parameter path is included.

parameters.name: Recursive
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the parameter path is recursive.
Default value: false.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description:
The field used to sort the results. Valid values:

- Name: the parameter name.

- CreatedDate: the creation time.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Ascending: ascending order.

- Descending (default): descending order.
